The references section is reasonably organized with conditional 'Read when' triggers.

However, it suffers from heavy truncation where critical details (procedure steps, validation criteria, gotchas) are deferred to a single folded-context file without adequate summaries in the main body. The lack of concrete executable examples and the abstract, jargon-dense language reduce actionability and conciseness.
